answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Reaching the nectar of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on invitation quota tree, taxed when attestations come from one subnet. Every claim climbs the wharf of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the terrace re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
